note: Single wooded loop on the bluffs above the Mississippi, sites screened by vegetation; overlooks of the river are a hike away. RVs check in by pulling up at the welcome center and walking down to the office. --Claude
summary: DNR spk00244 + ReserveMN 77 read: $24 confirmed (no electric); 31 back-in sites, DNR limit 60 ft (29 sites 43-60, two 25 ft); showers/flush seasonal, no dump; 2027 season 04-16..10-24. Pin moves ~1.4 km to the loop. DNR link fixed, phone added. Not waterfront kept.
flags: Pin: stored 43.94550,-91.40000 is on a gravel park road in forest ~1.4 km NW of the campground; the 31 ReserveMN unit points centre on 43.93839,-91.38534, where gravel pads show through the canopy at z18 -> move there.

Rig wording: the DNR says 'Sites big enough to accommodate RV's are limited.' while posting a 60-ft limit; ReserveMN lists 29 of 31 sites at 43 ft or more. A 23-ft rig fits; no caveat needed beyond the sites note.
Waterfront (kept not waterfront): wooded bluff-top loop; the Mississippi is ~1 km away and some 150 m below.
